name: Thornmail
tagline: Groups security logs into explainable cases with rule-based risk scores and AI notes, leaving the decision to analysts.

awards: D3 Security - Sponsor Challenge // D3 Security - Défi commandité

problem: Real threats are buried under thousands of noisy alerts.
solution: A pipeline ingests logs, clusters related activity into cases, scores risk with clear rules and uses a local LLM to surface key details and next steps.
demo_moment: Team-described: a dashboard of cases ranked by risk with explanations.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “D3 Security - Sponsor Challenge // D3 Security - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Keeps the analyst as the final decision maker.

lessons: In security, explainable and conservative beats clever.
